title: Daily Dose #360: Perfect Peace
body:
**“You keep him in perfect peace whose mind is stayed on you, because he trusts in you.”**

Peace is often treated as the absence of trouble. Isaiah describes something deeper: a person can be kept by God even while trouble remains.

The mind naturally stays on whatever it believes has the greatest power. When fear dominates, every possibility looks like a threat. When the mind is stayed on God, the problem does not disappear, but it is no longer the largest reality in view.

This is not a command to deny anxiety or pretend emotions can be switched off. Some struggles may also require professional support, wise counsel or medical care. Trusting God and receiving appropriate help are not enemies.

To keep the mind on God means repeatedly returning to what is true: He is present, He is wise, He hears prayer, and He remains God when we do not know what comes next.

When the mind runs ahead today, gently bring it back. Pray about the actual concern rather than every imagined version of it. Do what is yours to do, and leave what belongs to tomorrow with the Lord.

Peace grows where trust is practised.
